scientific_integrity: This result uses standard Haar moment identities and acknowledges Quillen's averaged-channel hypercube model and prior disordered-coin entanglement literature. Claims were assessed within a self-review; independent audit and external priority assessment have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Two unitary time steps only, localized pure starting position, shared and independent Haar U(d) coins, Q_d coordinate-flip shift and mean linear entanglement; no samplewise or longer-time monotonicity, no von Neumann entropy mean.
title: A dimension-three entanglement crossover for Haar-coin walks on hypercubes
